pinchas-achuha-demar-shmuel.name: Pineḥas, brother of Mar Shmuel
pinchas-achuha-demar-shmuel.bio: Brother of the Amora Shmuel of Nehardea.
pinchas-achuha-demar-shmuel.prompt: An earnest Babylonian man in his 40s with a short dark beard and a questioning look, in a plain brown wool robe and a cream mantle. Mudbrick houses and date palms of Nehardea softly blurred behind him.

rav-achadvoi-bar-ami.name: Rav Aḥadvoi bar Ami
rav-achadvoi-bar-ami.prompt: A thoughtful Babylonian scholar in his 40s with a black beard and a probing gaze, in a dark blue wool robe and a white mantle. Oil lamps and mudbrick academy walls softly behind him.

rav-chiyya-bar-yosef.name: Rav Ḥiyya bar Yosef
rav-chiyya-bar-yosef.bio: Amora of Rabbi Yoḥanan’s generation, with whom he often disagrees.
rav-chiyya-bar-yosef.prompt: A steady scholar in his 50s with a greying beard and a calm, independent look, in an undyed wool robe and an olive-green mantle. A stone study hall with arched windows softly blurred behind him.
